While many existing approaches train on short segments treated as independent samples, BTCNet incorporates information about when each segment occurs within its parent recording, for example within a sleep session. BTCNet further learns pairwise interactions between physiological signals via cross-attention, without requiring task labels or sequence-level supervision.
  We evaluate BTCNet on pediatric sleep data across six downstream tasks, including sleep staging, arousal detection, and respiratory event detection. Under frozen-backbone linear probing, BTCNet consistently outperforms an otherwise identical non-time-aware variant, with gains that generalize to an independent pediatric dataset. Compared to existing multimodal self-supervised sleep models, BTCNet achieves strong performance, particularly on respiration-related tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 BiTimeCrossNet（BTCNet）：一个面向儿童多导睡眠监测（PSG）的多模态自监督学习框架，其核心创新是在预训练阶段注入「整夜睡眠会话级」的时间上下文条件化（global time-aware conditioning），并通过随机模态对采样 + 双向交叉注意力学习信号间的成对生理耦合。在冻结主干 + 线性探测的协议下，BTCNet 在 NCH 上六项下游任务全部优于同构的非时间感知基线 BCNet，并在独立 CHAT 队列上保持优势；在呼吸相关任务（血氧下降、低通气、呼吸暂停）上超过 SleepFM 与 PedSleepMAE 等公开多模态 SSL 模型。
AI.motivation: 儿童睡眠分析存在三大缺口：(1) 成人数据训练的模型在儿童上泛化差，且面向儿童的 SSL 方法极少（此前仅 PedSleepMAE）；(2) 现有睡眠 SSL 多聚焦睡眠分期，而呼吸事件（呼吸暂停、低通气、血氧下降）这类与心脑血管、神经结局强相关的诊断任务被忽视；(3) 更根本的是，现有 SSL 以固定 30 秒窗为独立样本，patch 级位置编码无法表达「窗口处于整夜睡眠轨迹的何处」，而呼吸稳定性、自主神经张力、心率动态等在整夜睡眠周期与生物钟时间上系统变化。作者由此提出：在预训练阶段直接注入全局「入睡时间」上下文，而非像既往工作那样仅在下游端拼接会话级轨迹/拓扑特征作为增强。
AI.method: 两阶段预训练。Stage 1 单模态自监督：对 16 个生理通道（EEG 7、EOG 2、EMG 1、呼吸 3、气体交换 2、鼾声 1；CHAT 取其中重叠的 12 通道）各自训练一个 ViT 编码器（patch=8 采样点、掩码 50%、嵌入维 512、6 层 8 头），目标为 MAE 掩码重建 MSE 与基于 CLS token 的 NT-Xent 对比损失加权和（λ_con 线性升至 1.0），Adam lr 1e-4、warm-up+cosine 衰减、每 epoch 2000 迭代。Stage 2 跨模态自监督：每个 mini-batch 随机采样两个不同模态形成 2×P×D 双模态张量；嵌入先叠加可学习的三元位置编码（模态级 s_j + patch 级 t_p + token 级 n_{j,p}）；随后施加全局时间条件化——以样本在睡眠会话中的段序号 se_i 经会话长度统计标准化得 t̂_i，送入两层轻量网络产生逐通道 scale/shift (γ_i, β_i)，层归一化并以零初始化可学习标量门控保证初始为恒等映射，再做仿射调制 z ← γ_i ⊙ z + β_i（类 FiLM，但条件信号为全局睡眠时刻）；之后再次随机掩码 50% token，10 层双向交叉注意力编码器（每个模态注意对方剩余 patch）并加 sigmoid 门控注意力；Stage 2 目标同样为掩码重建 + NT-Xent，期间单模态编码器以 LoRA（r=8, α=16, dropout 0.05）微调。数据：NCH Sleep Databank 2,379 晚 PSG（约 233 万个 30 秒样本，80/10/10 划分），CHAT 422 例仅作外部验证。下游统一采用冻结主干 + 拼接双模态 CLS token（1024 维）+ 单层线性探针、类权重交叉熵；模态对筛选（120 种组合）仅用较弱的 BCNet 完成，以保证增益归因于时间感知而非选通道。PHATE/UMAP 用于可视化嵌入随时间的连贯性。
AI.result: NCH 线性探测（Table 1，3 种子）：BTCNet 在全部 6 项任务的 AUROC 与 F1 均高于 BCNet——血氧下降 AUROC 78.92→81.75、F1 38.91→44.80；低通气 82.96→86.13、25.35→29.49；低通气-呼吸暂停 82.83→86.04、31.40→36.55；呼吸暂停 82.16→85.11、17.46→21.41；EEG-觉醒 78.53→81.82、27.78→31.02；5 期睡眠分期 Acc 57.12→60.98、AUROC 79.90→83.67、F1 55.08→59.83；附录 D.3 的其余模态对同样全部改善。与基线对比（Table 2）：BTCNet 在呼吸类任务显著领先（血氧下降 F1 44.95 vs SleepFM 32.94 / PedSleepMAE 32.48），EEG-觉醒与分期上与基线相当或略优（NCH 分期 Acc 61.98 略低于 PedSleepMAE 71.88/SleepFM 71.95）。CHAT 跨数据集直接线性探测（Table 3）：BTCNet 呼吸任务大幅领先（血氧下降 AUROC 90.65、F1 68.01，优于所有 SleepFM 变体；低通气 88.00/42.42；A-H 88.32/49.89），但 EEG-觉醒与分期上 SleepFM 明显更好（如分期 Acc 78.59 vs 55.01）。CHAT 上 LoRA 微调对比（Table 10）：BTCNet 全面优于 BCNet，如血氧下降 AUROC 59.69→74.41、低通气 60.61→75.02、暂停 56.35→70.01、分期 62.05→79.93。PHATE 可视化显示时间感知模型的嵌入结构更平滑、连贯，事件点更可分。附带观察：SleepFM 使用 BTCNet 选出的模态对时在呼吸任务上表现优于使用全部模态，提示跨注意力学到的模态相关性具有迁移价值。
AI.conclusion: 将全局「入睡时间」上下文作为预训练期条件信号（而非下游增强或独立预测特征）是一种有效且可迁移的归纳偏置：在儿童 PSG 上它系统性地提升六项下游任务的 AUROC/F1，且增益在通道选择对基线有利、编码器冻结、探针为线性的严格控制下依然成立，并在独立 CHAT 队列（微调与跨数据集直推两种方式）保持，说明学到的是更稳健、临床意义更强的多模态睡眠表征，而非容量或选通道带来的假象；其收益在具有强烈整夜时序结构的呼吸事件任务上最显著，而在 EEG 主导任务上不损害性能但也未超越 SleepFM 等基线。局限与展望：仅使用双模态输入，在 EEG 觉醒与睡眠分期上不及 SleepFM；未来可探索纯对比式 SSL 变体、其他架构，以及在冻结表征之上加装轻量序列模型（如 RNN/SSM）以进一步提升下游表现。

title: VerIde ECG Biometrics: Verification and Identification
summary: This work studies electrocardiogram (ECG) biometrics at large scale, evaluating how strongly an ECG can be linked to an individual and, consequently, how its anonymization may be compromised. We show that identity information is already present in tabular representations (fiducial features): even a simple MLP-based embedding network yields non-trivial performance, indicating that anonymization based solely on releasing features does not guarantee privacy. We then adopt embedding-based deep learning models (ArcFace), first on features and then on ECG waveforms, showing a performance jump when moving from tabular inputs to waveforms, and a further gain with larger training sets and consistent normalization across train/val/test. On a large-scale test set, verification achieves high TAR at strict FAR thresholds (TAR=0.908 @ FAR=1e-3; TAR=0.820 @ FAR=1e-4) with EER=2.53% (all-vs-all); closed-set identification yields Rank@1=0.812 and Rank@10=0.910. In open-set, a two-stage pipeline (top-K shortlist on embeddings + re-ranking) reaches DIR@FAR up to 0.976 at FAR=1e-3 and 1e-4. Overall, the results show that ECG carries a measurable individual signature: re-identification is already possible with tabular features and is further amplified by embedding-based models, making privacy implications and realistic operational protocols essential to consider.

AI.tldr: 该文在真实临床大规模数据（测试集约2.3万身份、5.6万条ECG）上评估心电（ECG）生物特征的可链接性：身份信息在13维表格化fiducial特征中即已存在（简单MLP即可达到rank@1=0.350、TAR@FAR=1e-3=0.280），改用ArcFace处理12导联波形后性能大幅跃升（rank@1=0.812、rank@10=0.910、TAR@FAR=1e-3=0.908、TAR@FAR=1e-4=0.820、all-vs-all EER=2.53%），开集两阶段管线（top-K检索+重排序/判决）最高DIR@FAR=0.976（FAR=1e-3与1e-4）。结论是：仅以"发布特征"作为匿名化手段无法保证ECG隐私，大规模评估与操作性指标（TAR@FAR、DIR@FAR）是把ECG生物特征推向真实场景的关键。
AI.motivation: 核心动机有两层。其一，隐私动机：ECG被广泛视为可分享的"生物特征无关"数据，但本文要回答"一条ECG能否被链接回个体"以及"以表格特征形式发布是否等于匿名化"这一安全/隐私问题。其二，方法学动机：现有ECG生物特征文献绝大多数在中小规模数据库（PTB、ECG-ID多为10^2量级被试）、异质预处理与指标下报告"accuracy"，结果不可比且往往过于乐观；缺乏大规模、面向实际安全阈值的评测与协议，使研究难以标准化与复现。因此作者定位为"以大规模证据+操作性指标建立基准"，而非提出新损失函数或新架构。
AI.method:
数据：意大利ASUGI临床库约100万条ECG（Mortara算法fiducial特征 + 12导联10s波形、1kHz、16bit），筛出687,147条/191,355患者，经三步精炼（>2次检查且间隔>30天→生理范围异常值剔除并每患者限10次→仅保留ELI250设备），最终164,440条/53,079患者（2006-02至2020-12）。
阶段一（统计动机）：对每患者取间隔6–18个月的两次检查构建INTRA对（真实）与等量固定种子的INTER对（冒 impostor），在8个非冗余特征上计算Pearson/Spearman相关，用非参数检验、bootstrap、效应量评估分离度。
阶段二（深度生物特征评测）：三种方案——(a) 表格Siamese MLP（13维fiducial，全连接32-64-256 + BatchNorm/ReLU + dropout 0.1，128维L2归一化嵌入），用对比损失 L=yD²+(1-y)max(0,m-D)² 与三元组损失 max(0,D_ap-D_an+α)，涉及采样策略（随机/半难/难）；(b) ArcFace-MLP（表格，同骨干，训练时以Additive Angular Margin多类分类约束超球面角度，推理丢弃分类头仅用骨干+余弦相似度）；(c) ArcFace-Waveform CNN（12通道输入，16个Conv1d块，kernel 7/24/16/8、膨胀率递增至8，通道64→128→256→320→256→128→64，块4/10/15后MaxPool，AdaptiveAvgPool1d+线性投影至512/1024维并L2归一化）。
对比研究：表示形式（表格 vs 波形）、采样率（250/500/1000 Hz）、归一化（per_sample vs train_global）、训练集规模（dataset_id 1000/1001/1002，训练每人最少3/4/5次检查）、Siamese→ArcFace的消融。
协议与指标：全部按患者划分train/val/test（无泄漏）；验证用TAR@FAR（FAR=1e-3、1e-4）、EER（测试集全对全all-vs-all上三角，块状计数避免乐观偏置）、ROC/DET；闭集识别用Rank@K(CMC)、rank_k_95；开集用两阶段管线（第一阶段ArcFace嵌入余弦相似度取top-K候选，第二阶段对top-K用best-of-K最大分融合、top-K均值融合、s-norm三种分数聚合）并以冒 impostor标定阈值，报告DIR@FAR。
AI.result: 阶段一：INTRA/INTER在6–18个月窗口下稳定分离——Pearson 0.9964 vs 0.9853（差+0.0111）、Spearman 0.9547 vs 0.8951（差+0.0596），非参数检验拒绝H0，bootstrap/效应量稳健；在嵌入空间分离更强（intra=7,239 vs inter=200,000）：KS=0.965、AD=27,626.9（p<0.001）、Mann-Whitney U=5,068,344（p≈0）、CvM=2,290.96（p=4.26e-07）、Cohen's d=5.29、Cliff's Δ=0.993、Bhattacharyya=0.0647，距离反向AUC=0.9965。阶段二（消融路径）：Siamese表格 → ArcFace表格（小幅提升）→ ArcFace波形（首次大幅跃升）→ batch_norm改train_norm（同等波形设置再提升）→ 更大训练集（1001）再提升。Table 1：表格 rank@1=0.350 / rank@5=0.622 / rank@10=0.720 / TAR@FAR1e-3=0.280 / 1e-4=0.112；波形250Hz rank@1=0.651、TAR 0.810/0.624；500Hz rank@1=0.776、TAR 0.896/0.790；1kHz rank@1=0.812、rank@5=0.888、rank@10=0.910、TAR@FAR1e-3=0.908、1e-4=0.820，EER=2.53%（阈值0.305，对应TAR≈FAR≈2.5%），rank_k_95=59；训练集top-1近100%（已见身份）。开集（gallery=random_single，5,000模板/2,000已知探针/6,000冒 impostor）：DIR@FAR=1e-3/1e-4 分别为 bestofk 0.976/0.976、topkmean 0.903/0.854、s-norm 0.976/0.975，说明第一阶段候选已足够干净，第二阶段主要起判决/校准作用。
AI.conclusion: ECG携带可测量的个体签名：即使仅以低维表格特征发布，身份仍可被链接与再识别（rank@1=0.350），因此"仅发布特征即匿名"的假设不成立，ECG数据发布与匿名化协议必须把可链接性作为隐私风险面来评估；配合ArcFace波形嵌入与统一归一化、大训练集后，验证在极低FAR下仍保持高TAR（1e-3时0.908、1e-4时0.820），all-vs-all EER=2.53%，闭集识别rank@1=0.812/rank@10=0.910，开集两阶段管线DIR@FAR最高0.976，具备工程化"候选生成→重排序/验证"的watchlist部署价值。作者强调三点结论性判断：(i) 大规模（2万+身份、5.6万+ECG）评测是获得真实、可比指标的必需品，小库高准确率不可迁移；(ii) 应报告TAR@FAR、DIR@FAR等操作性指标而非含混的"accuracy"，并使用all-vs-all避免冒 impostor子采样带来的乐观偏置；(iii) 局限在于设备/中心同质化（仅ELI250）与异常值清洗限定了结论的适用域，跨设备与跨人群可迁移性尚未验证。后续工作包括在HEEDB等大规模外部库上做迁移/鲁棒性测试，以及单导联与冻结嵌入下各导联身份信息贡献量的量化分析。

title: Cross-Temporal Attention Fusion (CTAF) for Multimodal Physiological Signals in Self-Supervised Learning
summary: We study multimodal affect modeling when EEG and peripheral physiology are asynchronous, which most fusion methods ignore or handle with costly warping. We propose Cross-Temporal Attention Fusion (CTAF), a self-supervised module that learns soft bidirectional alignments between modalities and builds a robust clip embedding using time-aware cross attention, a lightweight fusion gate, and alignment-regularized contrastive objectives with optional weak supervision. On the K-EmoCon dataset, under leave-one-out cross-validation evaluation, CTAF yields higher cosine margins for matched pairs and better cross-modal token retrieval within one second, and it is competitive with the baseline on three-bin accuracy and macro-F1 while using few labels. Our contributions are a time-aware fusion mechanism that directly models correspondence, an alignment-driven self-supervised objective tailored to EEG and physiology, and an evaluation protocol that measures alignment quality itself. Our approach accounts for the coupling between the central and autonomic nervous systems in psychophysiological time series. These results indicate that CTAF is a strong step toward label-efficient, generalizable EEG-peripheral fusion under temporal asynchrony.

AI.tldr: CTAF 是一种用于异步多模态情感建模的自监督融合方法，通过跨时序注意力直接学习脑电与生理信号之间的软对齐，实现标注高效、泛化性强的融合。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态融合方法大多忽略或通过代价高昂的扭曲处理脑电与周边生理信号的异步问题，而这二者在精神生理时间序列中存在中枢-自主神经系统的耦合关系，需要专门建模其时序对齐。
AI.method: 提出跨时注意力融合（CTAF）模块：使用时序感知的交叉注意力学习模态间软双向对齐，结合轻量融合门控，以及带有对齐正则化的对比目标（可选弱监督）构建鲁棒片段嵌入。
AI.result: 在 K-EmoCon 数据集上，采用留一法交叉验证，CTAF 在匹配对上获得更高的余弦边距，在 1 秒内实现更好的跨模态令牌检索，同时在三分箱准确率和宏观‑F1 上性能与基线相当，且使用极少标注。
AI.conclusion: CTAF 是一种面向时序异步的脑电‑周边生理信号融合的有效方法，通过直接建模对应关系、专为脑电与生理信号设计的对齐驱动自监督目标，以及测量对齐质量的评估协议，向标注高效、泛化性强的融合迈出了重要一步。

authors: Telmo de Menezes e Silva Filho
title: LEMON: Local Explanations via Modality-aware OptimizatioN
summary: Multimodal models are ubiquitous, yet existing explainability methods are often single-modal, architecture-dependent, or too computationally expensive to run at scale. We introduce LEMON (Local Explanations via Modality-aware OptimizatioN), a model-agnostic framework for local explanations of multimodal predictions. LEMON fits a single modality-aware surrogate with group-structured sparsity to produce unified explanations that disentangle modality-level contributions and feature-level attributions. The approach treats the predictor as a black box and is computationally efficient, requiring relatively few forward passes while remaining faithful under repeated perturbations. We evaluate LEMON on vision-language question answering and a clinical prediction task with image, text, and tabular inputs, comparing against representative multimodal baselines. Across backbones, LEMON achieves competitive deletion-based faithfulness while reducing black-box evaluations by 35-67 times and runtime by 2-8 times compared to strong multimodal baselines.

AI.tldr: LEMON是一个模型无关的多模态预测局部解释框架，通过模态感知优化生解释，能解耦模态级贡献和特征级归因，大幅减少计算开销。
AI.motivation: 现有的可解释性方法往往是单模态的、与架构相关的，或者计算成本过高难以规模化应用，需要一种高效、模型无关的多模态解释框架。
AI.method: LEMON通过拟合具有组结构稀疏性的单模态感知替代模型来生成统一解释，将预测器视为黑盒，使用相对较少的正向传播，并在重复扰动下保持忠实性。
AI.result: 在视觉语言问答和临床预测任务上，LEMON在删除保真度方面具有竞争力，相比强大多模态基线，黑盒评估减少35-67倍，运行时间缩短2-8倍。
AI.conclusion: LEMON提供了一种计算高效、模型无关的多模态预测局部解释框架，能够解耦不同模态的贡献，并显著减少计算需求。

title: Structure-Preserving Learning Improves Geometry Generalization in Neural PDEs
summary: We aim to develop physics foundation models for science and engineering that provide real-time solutions to Partial Differential Equations (PDEs) which preserve structure and accuracy under adaptation to unseen geometries. To this end, we introduce General-Geometry Neural Whitney Forms (Geo-NeW): a data-driven finite element method. We jointly learn a differential operator and compatible reduced finite element spaces defined on the underlying geometry. The resulting model is solved to generate predictions, while exactly preserving physical conservation laws through Finite Element Exterior Calculus. Geometry enters the model as a discretized mesh both through a transformer-based encoding and as the basis for the learned finite element spaces. This explicitly connects the underlying geometry and imposed boundary conditions to the solution, providing a powerful inductive bias for learning neural PDEs, which we demonstrate improves generalization to unseen domains. We provide a novel parameterization of the constitutive model ensuring the existence and uniqueness of the solution. Our approach demonstrates state-of-the-art performance on several steady-state PDE benchmarks, and provides a significant improvement over conventional baselines on out-of-distribution geometries.

AI.tldr: Geo-NeW方法：使用数据驱动有限元方法，通过联合学习微分算子和几何上的兼容有限元空间，构建物理基础模型，在未见几何上保持结构精度和物理守恒定律。
AI.motivation: 开发物理基础模型，为科学和工程中的偏微分方程提供实时解，在适应未见几何时保持结构和精度。
AI.method: 引入Geo-NeW：数据驱动有限元方法，联合学习微分算子和在底层几何上定义的兼容降维有限元空间；使用有限元外积分法精确保持物理守恒定律；通过基于transformer的编码和学习的有限元空间将几何作为离散网格输入；提供本构模型的新参数化确保解的存在唯一性。
AI.result: 在多个稳态偏微分方程基准测试中表现出最优性能，在分布外几何上相比传统基线有显著改进。
AI.conclusion: Geo-NeW方法通过显式连接底层几何和边界条件与解，为学习神经偏微分方程提供了强大的归纳偏置，在未见域上提高了泛化能力。

title: Causality--Δ: Jacobian-Based Dependency Analysis in Flow Matching Models
summary: Flow matching learns a velocity field that transports a base distribution to data. We study how small latent perturbations propagate through these flows and show that Jacobian-vector products (JVPs) provide a practical lens on dependency structure in the generated features. We derive closed-form expressions for the optimal drift and its Jacobian in Gaussian and mixture-of-Gaussian settings, revealing that even globally nonlinear flows admit local affine structure. In low-dimensional synthetic benchmarks, numerical JVPs recover the analytical Jacobians. In image domains, composing the flow with an attribute classifier yields an attribute-level JVP estimator that recovers empirical correlations on MNIST and CelebA. Conditioning on small classifier-Jacobian norms reduces correlations in a way consistent with a hypothesized common-cause structure, while we emphasize that this conditioning is not a formal do intervention.

AI.tldr: 本文提出用 Jacobian-向量积（JVP）作为"因果探针"来度量流匹配模型内部/输出特征的依赖结构：理论上在高斯与混合高斯设定下推导了最优速度场及其 Jacobian 的闭式表达式，证明全局非线性漂移在局部可分解为仿射映射；实验上用有限差分 JVP 在 1D/2D 合成高斯、2D 混合高斯、像素级 MNIST（估计 0.8674 vs 真值 0.8813）与属性级 CelebA（用 1 万生成样本估计 0.16 vs 真值 0.40）上恢复依赖/相关结构；在 CelebA 上按分类器 Jacobian 范数 ||J^19||<1e-4 筛选子集后，属性 28 与 30 的相关降至约 0.04，与"Heavy_Makeup 为共同原因"的假设一致，但作者明确声明这只是条件化 P(y|小范数) 而非 Pearl 意义上的 do-干预，不构成形式化因果推断。
AI.motivation: 流匹配（flow matching）作为扩散/得分模型之外的确定性生成范式，能学习把基分布输运到数据分布的速度场，但其内部与输出的依赖结构难以解释：哪些潜在维度影响哪些生成特征、特征之间是否存在共同原因结构均不透明。已有的可解释性工作多聚焦于表征学习/解耦或 Pearson/Jacobian 正则，而因果学（Pearl 的因果阶梯）多停留在纯统计关联层面，缺少能在生成模型内部量化"扰动传播"的工具。作者希望回答：当潜变量发生小扰动时，扰动如何沿学习到的流传播到输出特征？Jacobian-向量积（JVP）正是描述这种局部线性响应的自然对象，因此可以作为估计依赖结构的实用探针。作者同时强调因果措辞的边界：其"干预"仅是基于 JVP 范数的条件化（conditioning），不是修改数据生成过程的 do-操作。
AI.method:
方法分理论推导与实验估计两部分。
(1) 理论部分：在线性插值 x_t=(1-t)x_0+t x_1 下，最优速度场为 u(x_t,t)=E[x_1-x_0|x_t]。对 x_0~N(0,I)、x_1~N(0,Σ) 用条件高斯恒等式得闭式漂移 v(x_t,t)=(tΣ-(1-t)I)[(1-t)²I+t²Σ]^{-1} x_t，为线性场，其 Jacobian A(t) 与 x_t 无关，且 A(t)A(t)^T 精确等于推前协方差。对高斯混合，先由贝叶斯得后验责任度 γ_k(x_t,t)=π_k N(x_t|m_{t,k},S_{t,k})/Σ_j π_j N(...)，边缘化得混合漂移 v=Σ_k γ_k[μ_k-μ_0+A_k(t)(x_t-m_{t,k})]，其 Jacobian 为 Σ_k γ_k A_k(t) + Σ_k(∇γ_k)[μ_k-μ_0+A_k(t)(x_t-m_k)]，即"仿射映射的凸组合 + softmax 梯度修正项"；∇γ_k 有显式形式 γ_k(S_k^{-1}(m_k-x_t)-Σ_j γ_j S_j^{-1}(m_j-x_t))。结论：即使全局非线性，单一成分占优处场局部仿射；干预视角（固定 K）Jacobian 分段常值，观测视角则平滑弯曲；协方差共享时 A_k(t)≡A(t)，仅偏置跳变。
(2) 几何部分：给出线性-高斯到高斯的显式微分同胚 φ_t(x_0)=m(t)+e^{tL}(x_0-m(0))，A=Σ_0^{-1/2}(Σ_0^{1/2}Σ_1Σ_0^{1/2})^{1/2}Σ_0^{-1/2}，L=log A，Jacobian Y(t)=e^{tL}，且有限差分精确恢复 Y(t)z，"抖动"协方差 ε²Y(t)Y(t)^T 与 Σ(t)=Y(t)Σ_0Y(t)^T 对应。
(3) 实验估计：对已训练流 f_θ，用有限差分近似 JVP（与自动微分 JVP 对比并做 ε 敏感性扫描）；像素级直接对生成图计算；属性级把流与训练好的属性分类器 C_θ 复合，计算 J_{C∘f}(x_0)z≈[C(f(x_0+εz))-C(f(x_0))]/ε；跨样本聚合二阶矩矩阵 S(D)=E[ΔyΔy^T]，再归一化得 Corr=D^{-1/2}S D^{-1/2}。用 CausalInference.jl 从 CelebA 40 个二值属性标签推断候选因果图（假设 Heavy_Makeup(19) 是 Pointy_Nose(28) 与 Rosy_Cheeks(30) 的共同原因），据此选子集做条件分析。
(4) 模型与设置：合成 1D/2D 高斯（MLP，1 万样本）；MNIST 取数字"5"子集、UNet 流模型（batch 64、lr 2e-4、1 万步）；CelebA 对齐裁剪 64×64、40 属性、ResNet50 分类器（BCE-with-logits，20 epoch）、10 000 生成样本，条件子集阈值 ||J^19||<1e-4（保留约 1700 样本）。代码开源（MIT）。
AI.result: 合成实验：1D 高斯到高斯的学习轨迹与解析轨迹一致（并纠正"流匹配学到的轨迹是直线"的常见误解——学的是分布条件期望而非点对点连线）；2D 混合高斯（K=3）数值 JVP 与解析 Jacobian 的平均偏差在 t=0 与 t=0.99 均 <0.001，成分重叠的中间时刻（t=0.25/0.5/0.75）偏差较大（0.18–0.30），与"成分可分时流退化为线性映射"的理论预期一致。像素级：MNIST 数字 5 中像素 (14,8) 与 (15,8) 的 JVP 估计相关为 0.8674，与数据集经验相关 0.8813 接近。属性级：CelebA 中属性 28 与 30 的经验相关约 0.40，JVP 估计为 0.16（仅用 1 万样本 vs 真值 20 万样本，作者认为样本量增加可改善）；在 ||J^19||→0 的条件子集上相关降至约 0.04，且估计出的 40×40 属性相关矩阵与标签计算的真值矩阵视觉上接近。整体结论是：JVP 可以在像素层与属性层恢复生成特征的依赖结构，且条件化于某属性的小 Jacobian 范数会降低另两属性的相关，与共同原因假设一致。
AI.conclusion:
论文给出两点主要结论：(i) 对高斯/混合高斯目标，流匹配的最优漂移虽全局非线性，但可分解为局部仿射结构，其 Jacobian 解析可算——干预下分段常值、观测下由 softmax 梯度项引入平滑非线性；(ii) 基于 JVP 的经验估计器能在合成数据、MNIST 像素与 CelebA 属性层面有效恢复依赖/相关结构，为可解释的流匹配模型提供了可行方法学基础。
作者反复强调的限定与边界：CelebA 上的"干预"实质是条件化 P(y| ||J|| 小)，而非 Pearl 意义上的 do-操作或对生成过程的反事实修改，故不构成形式化因果推断；对共同原因的存在也并非决定性证据，因为在纯关联解释下条件化共同原因同样会降低下游相关。
局限：闭式结论仅覆盖高斯/混合高斯，真实分布下局部仿射近似的质量未刻画；依赖预训练分类器引入归纳偏置；仅计算 JVP 而非全 Jacobian，高维下探针数量开销大；||J|| 阈值是启发式的且未做敏感性分析；未在含碰撞点（collider）等已知因果结构上检验（碰撞点应使相关上升，是重要 sanity check）。
未来方向：直接从流本身构造真正 do-操作；在含共同原因/碰撞点/中介者的合成因果图上做结构检验；推广到更丰富分布族；扩展到因果阶梯第三层反事实 P(y_x'|x,y)；用自动微分、随机化 sketch、幂迭代降低探针成本；与解耦文献中的 Jacobian 正则建立联系。

title: Joint Learning of Hierarchical Neural Options and Abstract World Model
summary: Building agents that can perform new skills by composing existing skills is a long-standing goal of AI agent research. Towards this end, we investigate how to efficiently acquire a sequence of skills, formalized as hierarchical neural options. However, existing model-free hierarchical reinforcement algorithms need a lot of data. We propose a novel method, which we call AgentOWL (Option and World model Learning Agent), that jointly learns -- in a sample efficient way -- an abstract world model (abstracting across both states and time) and a set of hierarchical neural options. We show, on a subset of Object-Centric Atari games, that our method can learn more skills using much less data than baseline methods.

AI.tldr: 提出AgentOWL方法，联合学习抽象世界模型和层次化神经选项，以更少的样本实现更多技能的获取。
AI.motivation: 构建能够通过组合现有技能来执行新技能的智能体是AI研究的长期目标，但现有模型无关的层次强化学习算法需要大量数据，不够高效。
AI.method: 提出AgentOWL方法，联合学习抽象世界模型（在状态和时间上抽象）和一组层次化神经选项，以提高样本效率。
AI.result: 在物体为中心的Atari游戏子集上验证，该方法比基线方法能用更少的数据学习更多技能。
AI.conclusion: AgentOWL方法通过联合学习抽象世界模型和层次化选项，显著提高了技能学习的样本效率。

title: Membership Inference Attacks from Causal Principles
summary: Membership Inference Attacks (MIAs) are widely used to quantify training data memorization and assess privacy risks. Standard evaluation requires repeated retraining, which is computationally costly for large models. One-run methods (single training with randomized data inclusion) and zero-run methods (post hoc evaluation) are often used instead, though their statistical validity remains unclear. To address this gap, we frame MIA evaluation as a causal inference problem, defining memorization as the causal effect of including a data point in the training set. This novel formulation reveals and formalizes key sources of bias in existing protocols: one-run methods suffer from interference between jointly included points, while zero-run evaluations popular for LLMs are confounded by non-random membership assignment. We derive causal analogues of standard MIA metrics and propose practical estimators for multi-run, one-run, and zero-run regimes with non-asymptotic consistency guarantees. Experiments on real-world data show that our approach enables reliable memorization measurement even when retraining is impractical and under distribution shift, providing a principled foundation for privacy evaluation in modern AI systems.

AI.tldr: 本文把成员推断攻击（MIA）的评估重新表述为一个因果推断问题——把"记忆化"定义为"将某数据点纳入训练集"对 MIA 分数的因果效应，从而形式化刻画了 one-run 协议中的点间干扰（interference）与 zero-run 协议中的分布偏移混淆（confounding），并给出带非渐近一致性保证的因果型 MIA 指标与实用估计量（IPW / G-Formula / AIPW），实验证明其在合成数据、CIFAR-10、预训练与微调 LLM 上都能有效"去偏"，尤其修正了 LLM 隐私评估中长期被高估的记忆化水平。
AI.motivation: 标准（multi-run）MIA 评估需要成百上千次重训练模型，对大模型代价过高，因此实践中广泛采用两类替代协议：one-run（单次训练、随机决定数据点是否入训，如 Steinke 等）与 zero-run（事后在已发布模型上直接评测，是当前 LLM 隐私审计的主流做法），但二者的统计有效性一直缺乏理论依据。已有工作指出 zero-run 评测存在系统性偏差：成员样本常取自训练截止日期之前（如早期 arXiv 论文、维基条目），非成员取自其之后，两者在主题、文体、时间语境上存在分布偏移，导致 MIA 成功反映的是分布差异而非真实记忆化，从而系统性高估隐私泄漏；同时 one-run 中多个数据点共同进入同一模型产生相互干扰（违反 SUTVA），破坏样本独立性与标准估计量的无偏性/一致性。作者的核心诉求是：明确"MIA 指标究竟在度量什么"，给出把 MIA 性能解释为真实记忆化所需的最小假设，并设计无需重训练、可扩展、可去偏的评估估计量——这对于无法与模型提供方合作、也无法重训的外部审计者（如评估大厂 LLM 的监管方）尤为关键。
AI.method: 1) 因果建模：将"数据点是否入训"作为处理 A，负对数似然/困惑度等 MIA 分数作为结果 Y，采用潜在结果框架定义 Y_i(1) 与 Y_i(0)；在干扰情形下推广为广义潜在结果 Y_i(ā)，并把训练算法 A 视为干扰的中介（mediator），给出对应因果图。2) 制度映射与分类：multi-run ↔ RCT；one-run ↔ 带干扰的 RCT（完整干扰图）；zero-run ↔ 带干扰与混淆的观测性研究（X→A 边源于分布偏移）。3) 因果指标体系（Table 1）：因果成员优势 ATE τ=E[Y(1)−Y(0)]、因果 TPR/FPR、因果 AUC、因果 TPR@固定 FPR，取代经典的 E[Y|A=1]−E[Y|A=0]、AUC、TPR@FPR。4) 识别与估计量：multi-run 下因果指标可识别且等于经典指标，ATE 估计量具有 Hoeffding 型界 |τ̂−τ| ≤ √(2t/n₁)+√(2t/n₀)；one-run 下用学习理论中的 α-误差稳定性与 β-一致训练稳定性作为对中介（训练算法）的假设，证明 |τ̂−τ| = O(√(t/n)+√(ntα²)+√(ntβ²))，并给出欠参数情形 D/n→0 时 τ≈0 的负面结果；zero-run 下引入域重叠假设（dP_T/dP_0 有界）与倾向得分 π(x)=P(A=1|X=x)，给出 IPW、G-Formula、AIPW（双重稳健）估计量及含 Δ_π̂ 与 (1/η) 因子的一致性界。5) 实验设计：合成高斯数据线性回归（过参数化岭回归 vs DP-SGD）、CIFAR-10 上 ResNet-16（成员 90% 干净/非成员 90% 加噪，人为协变量偏移）、预训练 Pythia-12b 上 6 个语料（MIMIR，BagOfWords+随机森林估计倾向得分）、Pythia-70m 用 LoRA 微调并以同分布切分构造 IID 伪真值对照。
AI.result: 理论上：三个制度的可识别性与因果指标被严格建立；one-run 的一致性在 α、β 稳定性下成立（完美插值时 β=0，只需 α=o(1/√n)，正则化凸/强凸问题天然满足；SGD+早停的非凸情形 α≈N^{−1+o(1)}），并给出参数化不足时攻击无信号的负面结论；zero-run 的 IPW 估计量偏差被分解为"倾向得分估计偏差 + 稳定性项 + 方差项"，且重叠假设退化为 η 越接近 0 权重越不稳定，可由 AIPW 缓解。实验上：(a) 合成数据中 multi-run 与 one-run 的 ROC/AUC 几乎重合（干扰可忽略），naive zero-run 在分布偏移下明显高估（AUC 0.669 vs 0.561），经倾向得分校正后（oracle 0.562、logistic 学习 0.595）回到非偏移基线；(b) DP-SGD 场景下 naive zero-run 的 ROC 甚至突破了 (ε,δ)=(0.602,0.01) 所蕴含的理论上界，校正后重新满足该上界；(c) CIFAR-10 ResNet-16 中 naive zero-run AUC≈0.72–0.75 被高估，校正后≈0.63–0.66，与 IID 基线≈0.65 吻合；(d) Pythia-12b 上 arxiv/github/pubmed_central 偏移强，naive 评测大幅虚高，去偏后 ROC 信号基本消失，指示真实记忆化很弱，而 hackernews/wikipedia/pile_cc 偏移弱、校正幅度相应温和；(e) 微调 LLM 上 naive 的 (B₁,T) 对比 AUC>0.95，校正后降至≈0.6，与同分布 (B₁,B₂) 伪真值一致。
AI.conclusion: 该工作把 MIA 评估从"预测性/博弈式"框架推进为"因果推断"框架：明确指出 one-run 的偏差源于点间干扰（可通过训练算法的稳定性加以约束），zero-run 的偏差源于成员/非成员的非随机分配与分布偏移（可通过倾向得分调整加以校正），并为三种制度提供了统一的因果指标与非渐近一致性保证，附带"随机干扰下的因果效应估计"这一具有独立价值的方法论副产品。实践意义在于：外部审计者无需模型方配合、无需重训练、仅用一个二分分类器即可得到可信赖的记忆化度量，尤其纠正了当前 LLM 隐私报告中普遍高估记忆化的现象。作者同时指明局限与方向：目前聚焦群体平均（ATE/ATT）效应，尚未处理子群层面的异质处理效应；因果 AUC 在干扰下一般不可识别（需更强的联合条件无混淆假设）；该视角可推广到属性推断等其他隐私攻击的去偏；前提假设（重叠性、稳定性、倾向得分可由低维表征学习）仍是方法生效的关键约束。

title: From Tokens to Numbers: Continuous Number Modeling for SVG Generation
summary: For certain image generation tasks, vector graphics such as Scalable Vector Graphics (SVGs) offer clear benefits such as increased flexibility, size efficiency, and editing ease, but remain less explored than raster-based approaches. A core challenge is that the numerical, geometric parameters, which make up a large proportion of SVGs, are inefficiently encoded as long sequences of tokens. This slows training, reduces accuracy, and hurts generalization. To address these problems, we propose Continuous Number Modeling (CNM), an approach that directly models numbers as first-class, continuous values rather than discrete tokens. This formulation restores the mathematical elegance of the representation by aligning the model's inputs with the data's continuous nature, removing discretization artifacts introduced by token-based encoding. We then train a multimodal transformer on 2 million raster-to-SVG samples, followed by fine-tuning via reinforcement learning using perceptual feedback to further improve visual quality. Our approach improves training speed by over 30% while maintaining higher perceptual fidelity compared to alternative approaches. This work establishes CNM as a practical and efficient approach for high-quality vector generation, with potential for broader applications. We make our code available http://github.com/mikeogezi/CNM.

AI.tldr: 本文提出连续数值建模（CNM）：把 SVG 中的浮点几何参数当作一阶连续变量直接建模，而非拆成数字级离散 token，从而把测试序列长度从 1,189 降到 549 token（-54%）、SFT 每步训练耗时降低 32%，同时在 SVG-Stack 上取得 SOTA 的 SSIM（54.1%，RL 后 55.9%）与 DINOv2 相似度（42.5%→44.8%）；并额外提出二进制存储格式 SVGFloat（float16 相比原始 SVG 压缩 1.73×）。
AI.motivation: 矢量图形（SVG）在需要精度、可组合性与可编辑性的场景（UI 设计、数据可视化、程序化插画）优于栅格格式，但生成式研究多聚焦栅格。SVG 序列化后是长度极长的 token 序列，其中大部分是浮点几何参数；用通用 LLM 分词器（如 Qwen）时，"123.456" 会被拆成 7 个 token（一位数字一个 token）。这种碎片化带来三重问题：(1) 序列长度、显存与训练成本膨胀；(2) 精度损失与量化/离散化伪影；(3) 建模目标与 SVG 数据中"相邻数值高度相关"的连续结构不匹配，损害泛化。作者希望恢复表示的数学优雅性，让模型输入与数据的连续本质对齐。
AI.method: 两阶段框架。第一阶段 CNM：把每个 SVG 解析为两条并行序列——(i) token 序列（保留全部符号 token，把每个浮点字面量替换为特殊占位符 [NUM]），(ii) float 序列（按顺序存放原始标量）。数值侧由专用模块处理：Number Encoder = Normalizer（按画布常数 M=512 归一化到 [-1,1]，训练时注入高斯噪声 σ_noise=0.2 以缓解曝光偏差）+ Fourier 特征映射（k=16 个指数递增频率的 sin/cos，输出 2k 维）+ MLP（GELU、2 隐层）投影到主干 d 维嵌入空间；Number Decoder = MLP（取该 [NUM] 位置的最后隐状态回归归一化标量）+ De-normalizer（乘回 M）。多模态骨干为 Qwen2-VL-2B-Instruct，图像由其现成视觉编码器切成 patch 嵌入，与 token/数值嵌入拼接融合后送入单一 Transformer 解码器。联合损失 L = CE（结构预测）+ λ·MSE（数值回归，λ=1e-5，因 MSE 量级远大于 CE），混合精度：主干 bfloat16 + 编解码器 float32。第二阶段 RL：在 SFT 之上用 GRPO（每图采样 8 个候选，temp=1、top_k=50、top_p=0.95），奖励为加权感知奖励 R = 0.4·DINOv2sim + 0.3·SSIM + 0.3·LPIPS'（LPIPS' 取相似度而非距离，全部归一到 [0,1]），KL 约束 0.001，200 步、lr=1e-6、批 2048。第三项贡献是 SVGFloat：ASCII 结构 + 二进制浮点的单流混合格式，用 IEEE 754 NaN-boxing 把路径命令 opcode 编码进 NaN 尾数位，数值以 float32/float16/bfloat16 定长存储，支持 float16/bfloat16。数据侧用 SVGO 简化、递归缩放到 [-512,512]² 画布、cairosvg 渲染做 SSIM>0.99 的质量控制筛选，剩 2.17M 训练/108K 验证/5.71K 测试样本。
AI.result: SVG-Stack 测试集（3 seeds 均值，同骨干/同数据/同 epoch）：CNM-SFT 序列长度 549 vs StarVector 1189（-54%），训练每批 0.71s vs 1.04s（加速 32%），推理 0.47s vs 0.51s（8%）；质量上 SSIM 54.1%（StarVector 48.5%、OmniSVG 46.0%）、LPIPS' 45.3%、DINOv2 42.5% 均领先；一次生成合法率 66.2%（vs 55.0%/60.9%）；CC/SL 4.51 vs 1.24。RL 后 SSIM 55.9%、LPIPS' 46.0%、DINOv2 44.8%，但训练步时间升至 3.07s、序列长度微增 549、CC/SL 降至 4.51。值得注意的是坐标级 √MSE 反而更高（82.4/79.6 vs StarVector 58.4），即感知指标提升与逐坐标回归精度并非完全一致。分词压缩对比：默认 1.00×、number-aware 1.61×、本文 4.67×。SVGFloat：float32 1.14×/0.91×（vs raw/gzip），float16 1.73×/1.23×，bfloat16 1.73×/1.31×，SSIM 分别 0.986/0.985/0.962。消融：连续表示 0.53 vs 量化 0.49（宽松 SSIM 下与默认 tokenizer 同为 0.53）；Fourier 0.53 vs 线性投影 0.44；M=512/1024 同为 0.53、M=1536 降至 0.52；噪声 σ=0 最差 0.50，σ=0.2 最优 0.53；RL 奖励三指标全用最好 0.54（SSIM 单项也 0.54），仅 DINOv2 单项 0.52 偏低；精度格式 bfloat16+float32 最佳 0.53。
AI.conclusion: CNM 证明了把连续几何参数作为一阶连续变量建模（配合 Fourier 特征编码与专用解码头）是可行的：在序列长度、训练/推理效率与感知保真度上同时优于数字级 tokenization（StarVector）与量化（OmniSVG）路线，且连续动作空间上的 RL 感知对齐带来额外增益。贡献包括：连续数值编码范式、同预算下多种数值表示的系统对比、以及二进制存储格式 SVGFloat。局限与遗留问题：数值 MSE 未同步改善；SFT+RL 的训练耗时明显上升（0.71s→3.07s）且序列长度/压缩率略有回退；有效性率仍仅 66%，需宽松回退策略；评测以单数据集与 2B 级骨干为主，规模化与跨领域泛化有待验证。

title: A Single Revision Step Improves Token-Efficient LLM Reasoning
summary:
Large language models (LLMs) achieve higher accuracy on challenging reasoning tasks by scaling test-time compute through multiple trajectory sampling. However, standard aggregation methods like majority voting or individual confidence-based filtering face a fundamental "blind spot": they evaluate each trace in isolation. As problems scale in difficulty, models often generate hallucinated paths that exhibit misleadingly high confidence, causing the true solution to be suppressed by a narrow margin in traditional voting. We ask: can we enable traces to "peer-review" each other to resolve these near-miss errors?
  We introduce Packet-Conditioned Revision (PACER), a training-free, inference-only framework that enables reasoning traces to revise their conclusions through a structured coordination step. After a preliminary screening of generated traces, PACER constructs a compact consensus packet containing (i) unique candidate answers, (ii) their aggregated confidence scores, and (iii) representative reasoning summaries for each candidate answer. Individual traces then perform a targeted self-review conditioned on this packet, allowing them to identify specific logical junctions where they diverged from the broader consensus and pivot if their original reasoning is found to be flawed. Final predictions are obtained via confidence-weighted voting over these revised trajectories. On challenging competitive math benchmarks such as AIME and BRUMO, PACER matches or exceeds the accuracy of 256-sample majority voting, significantly outperforming raw ensemble baselines by transforming simple consensus into a collaborative logical refinement process.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 PACER（Packet-Conditioned Revision，包条件修订）：一种免训练、仅推理阶段的协调框架，在置信度引导采样（DeepConf-Online）之上插入"一步共识条件修订"，让各条推理轨迹基于一个低带宽"共识包"（Top-N 候选答案、置信加权支持度、每答案代表性推理摘要）互相"审稿"，可改写自己的答案，最后用置信加权投票输出。在 AIME 2024/2025、HMMT 2025、BRUMO 2025 上，PACER 以远少于 MV@256 的生成 token 达到或超过 256 样本多数投票的准确率（如 GPT-OSS-120B 在 HMMT 2025 上 28/30 vs 25/30）。
AI.motivation: LLM 通过多条轨迹采样扩展测试时计算可提升推理准确率，但标准聚合方法（多数投票 MV/self-consistency、基于置信度的过滤如 DeepConf）存在"盲区"：它们把每条轨迹当作孤立个体来评估。随着题目难度上升，模型常生成"高置信度幻觉路径"，这些错误轨迹能骗过置信度筛选器，使正确答案在投票中被微弱多数压制（near-miss）。已有 token 效率方法（DeepConf、ESC、CGES 等）虽自适应分配算力，但仍保持"轨迹独立"这一结构性假设；自精炼（Self-Refine）只基于单条轨迹内省、缺少同伴证据；多智能体辩论（多轮交互）延迟与 token 成本过高。作者因此提出核心问题：能否以最小、免训练的测试时协调步骤，让轨迹借助同伴证据完成一次修订，同时保留置信度引导采样的 token 节省？
AI.method:
三阶段流水线（Algorithm 1），全部免训练：
(1) 置信度在线筛选（复现的 DeepConf-Online 变体）：定义 top-k 负对数概率不确定度 U_t 与窗口均值 Ū_t，取前缀不稳定度 I_t = max_{r≤t} Ū_r，前缀稳定性 S_t = -I_t（单调不增）；先用 N_init=64 条完整 warmup 轨迹，按尾部百分位设阈值 s = Percentile({S}, 100-η)（η=10 → Top-10% 筛选），之后逐 token 解码，一旦 S_t < s 即早停丢弃；稳定池 T = {warmup 中 S≥s} ∪ {存活在线轨迹}，实际完成轨迹数 B 依数据而定（约 20–25）。
(2) 共识包构造（双过滤）：对每个唯一答案计算置信加权支持度 V(a)=Σ S(τ)·1[a_i=a]，取 Top-N 候选（实验 P=80）；每个候选选一条 S(τ) 最大的代表轨迹，其理由按固定预算 L_sum 确定性截断（实现中 PacketTokens=0）。包 P = {(a, V(a), R_a)}，开销 O(N·L_sum) 而非 O(B)。
(3) 单轮共识条件修订 + 聚合：每条轨迹获得原题、自身解答与共识包，在 L_rev token 预算内做定向自审（"支持度感知"与"理由对照"两种纠错机制），可保留或改写答案；最终以原始稳定性加权的置信加权投票（式15）给出预测。作者还给出"修复 vs 损坏"分析：修复率 α、损坏率 β，条件 (1-p)α ≥ pβ 下单轨迹准确率不降；引入共识边际 Δ = V(a⁽¹⁾) - max_{a≠a⁽¹⁾} V(a)，在边际单调假设下 Δ≥Δ₀ 时修订更有益；由 Hoeffding 型界 Pr(â≠y*|Δ) ≤ exp(-2B(p'-1/2)²) 说明单轨迹正确率提升可指数级降低投票误差，且在 MV 收益递减区间内，修訂 token 的"每 token 收益"优于再采样若干条完整轨迹。
AI.result: 主结果（N_try=256, P=80）：GPT-OSS-120B —— AIME 2025：PACER 29/30 vs Online 27/30 vs MV 27/30；BRUMO 2025：27/30 vs 26/30 vs 27/30；HMMT 2025：28/30 vs 25/30 vs 25/30（较 DeepConf-Online 提升 +10.0 个百分点）。DeepSeek（蒸馏 Qwen 系列）：AIME 2025：27/30 vs 26/30 vs 24/30；BRUMO 2025：29/30 vs 28/30 vs 28/30；HMMT 2025：23/30 vs 23/30 vs 21/30。总体结论：DeepConf 能滤除噪声、常与 MV 持平，但在"模型集体收敛到貌似合理的干扰项"的硬错误上存在天花板；PACER 通过向存活轨迹暴露分歧的同伴理由使其切换到正确路径，在困难基准上稳定多解出 2–3 题，且跨架构（两种模型）一致有效。消融：相较朴素自精炼，PACER 的定向修订节省约 17%–28% Phase-2 token 而保持准确率；精度–token Pareto 前沿整体上移（相对 MV 与 DeepConf-Online）。附录案例分析（AIME 2024 极值题 188→240、BRUMO 期望抽牌题 1354/65→737/39）显示模型在收到共识包后能识别"逻辑陷阱"（把"恰好两个极小值"误当三根、假设无放回抽样下阶段等待独立）并自我纠正。
AI.conclusion: PACER 表明：只需一次低 token 的、条件于结构化共识摘要的修订，就能把"简单计数式共识"转变为"协作式逻辑精炼"，从而在严格 token 预算下逼近甚至超过大规模多数投票的准确率。理论上，收益来源于"修复率高、损坏率低"的不对称条件，并随共识边际 Δ 增大而增强；由于在固定池大小下投票误差随单轨迹正确率超 1/2 的程度指数衰减，少量高准确率轨迹可胜过单轨迹正确率接近 1/2 的大规模集成，使一次性修订成为 MV 收益饱和后更划算的 token 支出方式。论文定位为可插拔的推理时协调层，不替代停止规则，也无需额外验证器或训练。局限与后续方向：实验基准规模小（每个 30 题、噪声较大）、等 token 预算下的对照曲线披露有限，包内摘要采用确定性截断而非模型摘要（摘要质量的影响有待消融），理论依赖边际单调与条件独立等可检验假设，作者建议结合安全缓解措施部署更强的推理时方法。

title: SC3D: Dynamic and Differentiable Causal Discovery for Temporal and Instantaneous Graphs
summary: Discovering causal structures from multivariate time series is a key problem because interactions span across multiple lags and possibly involve instantaneous dependencies. Additionally, the search space of the dynamic graphs is combinatorial in nature. In this study, we propose \textit{Stable Causal Dynamic Differentiable Discovery (SC3D)}, a two-stage differentiable framework that jointly learns lag-specific adjacency matrices and, if present, an instantaneous directed acyclic graph (DAG). In Stage 1, SC3D performs edge preselection through node-wise prediction to obtain masks for lagged and instantaneous edges, whereas Stage 2 refines these masks by optimizing a likelihood with sparsity along with enforcing acyclicity on the instantaneous block. Numerical results across synthetic and benchmark dynamical systems demonstrate that SC3D achieves improved stability and more accurate recovery of both lagged and instantaneous causal structures compared to existing temporal baselines.

AI.tldr: SC3D是一个两阶段的可微分框架，用于从时间序列数据中联合学习时滞特定邻接矩阵和可能的瞬时有向无环图，通过稳定性提升和准确因果结构恢复。
AI.motivation: 多元时间序列中的因果结构发现问题面临挑战，因为跨多个时滞的交互作用和可能存在的瞬时依赖关系，而动态图的搜索空间本质上是组合性的，需要更稳定准确的恢复方法。
AI.method: SC3D采用两阶段可微分框架：第一阶段通过节点预测进行边预选获得时滞边和瞬时边的掩码；第二阶段通过优化稀疏化似然并强制即时块的无环性来细化这些掩码。
AI.result: 在合成和基准动力系统上的数值结果表明，SC3D相比现有时序基线方法，实现了更好的稳定性和更准确的时滞及瞬时因果结构恢复性能。
AI.conclusion: SC3D两阶段可微分框架能够有效处理时间序列中的因果发现，特别是对包含多个时滞和可能瞬时依赖的复杂动态系统，在稳定性和准确性方面都有显著改进。

title: Koopman Autoencoders with Continuous-Time Latent Dynamics for Fluid Dynamics Forecasting
summary: Data-driven surrogate models have emerged as powerful tools for accelerating the simulation of turbulent flows. However, classical approaches which perform autoregressive rollouts often trade off between strong short-term accuracy and long-horizon stability. Koopman autoencoders, inspired by Koopman operator theory, provide a physics-based alternative by mapping nonlinear dynamics into a latent space where linear evolution is conducted. In practice, most existing formulations operate in a discrete-time setting, limiting temporal flexibility. In this work, we introduce a continuous-time Koopman framework that models latent evolution through numerical integration schemes. By allowing variable timesteps at inference, the method demonstrates robustness to temporal resolution and generalizes beyond training regimes. In addition, the learned dynamics closely adhere to the analytical matrix exponential solution, enabling efficient long-horizon forecasting. We evaluate the approach on classical CFD benchmarks and report accuracy, stability, and extrapolation properties.

AI.tldr: 本文提出连续时间 Koopman 自编码器（KAE）：隐层动力学由线性 ODE dz/dt = K_cont z 给出，推理时用矩阵指数 z(τ)=exp(K_cont τ)z(0) 一步直达任意时刻，从而把预测成本与预测时长解耦；在不可压尾流、跨声速圆柱绕流与 Kuramoto–Sivashinsky 方程上实现稳定长时程外推（240/1000 步不发散）、相对扩散模型约 110× 的推理加速，并在变分数据同化（初始状态反演）中优于 SDA/U-Net/FNO/ACDM，代价与同化窗口长度无关。核心洞见是"前向预报精度并不预示同化精度"。
AI.motivation: 数据驱动代理模型在加速湍流/复杂物理系统仿真上已具价值，但自回归方法存在"短期精度—长时程稳定性"的权衡：逐 rollout 误差累积、推理成本随预测步数线性增长；同时离散时间 Koopman 自编码器（KAE）的隐层算子与训练时间步 Δt 绑定，难以处理不规则采样或未见时间步。已有连续时间 Koopman 工作要么保留非线性项需数值积分，要么仅针对低维理想系统。另一侧，数据同化（从稀疏观测反演未知状态）长期被忽视，且现有研究多以数值求解器或自回归代理作为前向模型，导致误差累积与昂贵的梯度反传。作者还注意到：强预报器未必是强同化器，这一点缺少系统对比。因此需要在统一框架下同时研究长时程稳定预报与快速准确的状态反演。
AI.method: 模型（KAE）：编码器-线性潜变量-解码器的模块化设计。空间编码器为带坐标通道注入的卷积残差网络（GroupNorm+SiLU、谱归一化、三级下采样、CBAM注意力、线性投影到潜空间），历史编码器用带正弦位置编码的 Transformer 对两帧（AR-2）上下文聚合后取均值；解码器为 CNN（AdaGN 条件化残差块、最近邻上采样+卷积）。潜动力学生效为线性连续时间生成元 dz/dt = K_cont(φ) z，其中 K_cont(φ)=K_0+N_ψ(φ)，条件参数（雷诺数/马赫数）经 RBF 式嵌入由超网络预测 LoRA 低秩修正（参数由 O(N_z²) 降至 O(2rN_z)），训练时对 φ 注入小高斯噪声以平滑参数空间；训练积分器为 RK4（刚性工况可选隐式中点/Radau IIA），推理用解析矩阵指数。训练目标 L = L_recon + αL_pred + βL_latent + λ_phys L_phys，其中 L_latent 含前后向线性一致性（Azencot 连续化）、方向余弦相似度、潜变量范数（能量）正则；L_phys 含时间/空间 Sobolev 与频谱一致性。数据同化：以隐变量 z_0 为控制变量，预计算 Φ_i=exp(K τ_i)（冻结模型、循环外一次性构建），损失为解码观测残差 J=(1/N)Σ||M_i⊙(D(Φ_i z)-y_i)||²，Adam 梯度优化；warm start 用 z_0=exp(-K τ_1)E(y_1)。与自回归基线的敏感性对比显示：Koopman 形式的 ∂x_t/∂x_0 = J_ψ(z_t)e^{At}J_φ(x_0) 只需一次矩阵指数，成本不随预测步数增长。基线包括 ResNet(-dil)、FNO16/32、TF_Enc/MGN/VAE、U-Net 系列、Refiner、ACDM（扩散）及 SDA（score-based）、4D-Var 变分同化算法。数据集：不可压尾流（Re∈[100,1000]，训练[200,900]，外推[100,180]/[920,1000]）、跨声速圆柱绕流（Re=10⁴，Ma∈[0.5,0.9]，训练[0.53,0.63]∪[0.69,0.90]，测试[0.50,0.52]/[0.66,0.68]/长程[0.64,0.65]）以及自生成 KS 方程（64 点周期、Δt=0.1、Lyapunov 时间 22.6、不规则帧丢弃实验）。
AI.result: 前向预报：不可压外推两区间均优于 ACDM（1.3/2.9 vs 1.7/0.8 量级）；跨声速短时误差略逊于 ACDM/U-Net，但 240 步长程 MSE 14.9e-3 最优（FNO32、Refiner 发散），单步推理 1.15 ms vs ACDM 126.57 ms（约 110× 加速），显存亦低；1000 步极端 rollout 中 KAE 误差有界、空间相关稳定，ACDM 相位与纹理崩塌；RK4 与矩阵指数轨迹高度一致，生成元特征值多数位于左半平面（Re λ<0）；可在未见 Δt∈{0.05,0.1,0.2} 零样本推理；KS 上 R=1 训练 100 步发散，R=2→10 逐步改善；随机丢弃 90% 帧仍保持稳定。物理条件化 LoRA 移除后误差升约两个数量级，full-rank MLP 参数化外推显著变差（1.3→10.4）。同化：KAE 在 KS 与跨声速上均显著优于 SDA/U-Net/FNO/ACDM++；ACDM++ 在 δ_f 增大时误差迅速恶化并接近 climatology，U-Net/FNO 常不优于"直接拷贝最近观测"基线，KAE 是唯一在整个 δ_f=1–20 范围内均优于两条参考基线的方法；敏感性/成本分析显示 Koopman 灵敏度查询成本与视界无关（双阱势系统示例）。消融（表11）表明去掉 directional-cosine 的变体预报最好但同化最差，去掉结构正则的变体预报最差而同化次优，说明预报与同化是两种独立能力。
AI.conclusion: 连续时间 Koopman 自编码器在长时程稳定预报与快速数据同化两方面均具优势：线性潜动力学给出闭式解，天然支持不规则观测时间与未见时间步，预测成本与预测长度解耦，且梯度稳定性由生成元谱而非连乘雅可比控制。论文的核心贡献是方法论层面的警示：前向预报精度不足以刻画代理模型在状态估计中的 usefulness，预报与同化应作为 Learned surrogate 的两个独立维度分别评测，并需要专门针对同化的架构/损失设计。局限：仅在两个流体系统与 KS 上验证；同化仍依赖迭代优化，计算优势取决于观测配置与优化过程；KAE 长时间程会丢失细尺度纹理（表现为低通滤波、稳定极限环），需在更复杂系统与更真实观测条件下进一步验证。

title: Tabula RASA: Exposing and Breaking the Relational Bottleneck in Transformers
summary: Transformers achieve remarkable performance across many domains, yet struggle with tasks requiring multi-hop relational reasoning over structured data. We analyze this limitation through circuit complexity: standard transformers are $\mathsf{TC}^0$-complete and require $Ω(k)$ layers for $k$-hop reasoning. We introduce RASA (Relation-Aware Sparse Attention), a minimal modification adding: (1) edge-type embeddings that inject relational structure into attention scores, and (2) sparse masking that restricts attention to graph-adjacent positions. While RASA has the same asymptotic depth requirements, sparse masking reduces the attention search space from $O(2^{n^2})$ to $O(2^m)$ patterns, and edge biases provide explicit relation routing. Empirically, on MetaQA (1/2/3-hop) and WebQuestionsSP, RASA outperforms standard transformers and matches GPT-4 at lower cost, with advantages growing with reasoning depth (+7.1 points on 3-hop). We do not claim formal learnability guarantees; the contribution is empirical validation that minimal structural modifications substantially improve multi-hop reasoning.

AI.tldr: RASA通过添加关系感知的稀疏注意力机制，提升Transformer在结构化数据上的多跳关系推理能力
AI.motivation: 标准Transformer在多跳关系推理任务上表现有限，电路复杂度分析表明其需要Ω(k)层来实现k跳推理，需要更高效的机制
AI.method: 提出RASA（关系感知稀疏注意力）：1）引入边类型嵌入将关系结构注入注意力分数；2）稀疏掩码限制注意力到图邻接位置，将注意力搜索空间从O(2^{n^2})减少到O(2^m)
AI.result: 在MetaQA（1/2/3跳）和WebQuestionsSP上，RASA性能优于标准Transformer，以更低成本匹配GPT-4性能，优势随推理深度增加（3跳任务+7.1分）
AI.conclusion: 虽然不提供形式化学习保证，但经验证明最小结构修改能显著改善多跳推理，关系感知和稀疏注意力的结合有效提升了Transformer的关系推理能力

title: Semantics-Aware Generative Latent Data Augmentation for Learning in Low-Resource Domains
summary: Despite strong performance in data-rich regimes, deep learning often underperforms in the data-scarce settings common in practice. While foundation models (FMs) trained on massive datasets demonstrate strong generalization by extracting general-purpose features, they can still suffer from scarce labeled data during downstream fine-tuning. To address this, we propose GeLDA, a semantics-aware generative latent data augmentation framework that leverages conditional diffusion models to synthesize samples in an FM-induced latent space. Because this space is low-dimensional and concentrates task-relevant information compared to the input space, GeLDA enables efficient, high-quality data generation. GeLDA conditions generation on auxiliary feature vectors that capture semantic relationships among classes or subdomains, facilitating data augmentation in low-resource domains. We validate GeLDA in two large-scale recognition tasks: (a) in zero-shot language-specific speech emotion recognition, GeLDA improves the Whisper-large baseline's unweighted average recall by 6.13%; and (b) in long-tailed image classification, it achieves 74.7% tail-class accuracy on ImageNet-LT, setting a new state-of-the-art result.

AI.tldr: GeLDA——一种基于语义感知的生成式隐空间数据增强框架，通过条件扩散模型在基础模型诱导的隐空间中合成样本，解决了数据稀缺环境下的深度学习性能瓶颈问题。
AI.motivation: 当前深度学习在数据丰富环境下表现优异，但在实际应用中常见的数据稀缺场景下表现不佳。尽管基于海量数据训练的基础模型通过提取通用特征展现出强大的泛化能力，但在下游微调阶段仍面临标注数据稀缺的挑战。因此需要一种能够在低资源领域高效生成高质量数据的方法。
AI.method: GeLDA提出了一种语义感知的生成式隐空间数据增强框架：1）利用基础模型将输入映射到低维隐空间，该空间压缩了任务相关信息；2）采用条件扩散模型在该隐空间中生成样本；3）通过捕获类间或子领域间语义关系的辅助特征向量来条件化生成过程；4）在生成过程中考虑语义关系，针对长尾分类等场景进行优化。
AI.result: 在两个大规模识别任务中验证了GeLDA的有效性：1）在零样本语言特定语音情感识别任务中，将Whisper-large基线的未加权平均召回率提升了6.13%；2）在长尾图像分类任务中，在ImageNet-LT上实现了74.7%的尾部类别准确率，创下了新的最先进结果。
AI.conclusion: GeLDA通过将数据增强从传统输入空间转移到基础模型诱导的语义丰富且低维的隐空间，显著提升了在数据稀缺场景下的深度学习性能。该方法不仅实现了高效、高质量的数据生成，还能够通过语义条件化有效处理长尾分布等挑战性问题，为零样本学习和低资源领域任务提供了有效的解决方案。

title: Causal Flow Q-Learning for Robust Offline Reinforcement Learning
summary: Expressive policies based on flow-matching have been successfully applied in reinforcement learning (RL) more recently due to their ability to model complex action distributions from offline data. These algorithms build on standard policy gradients, which assume that there is no unmeasured confounding in the data. However, this condition does not necessarily hold for pixel-based demonstrations when a mismatch exists between the demonstrator's and the learner's sensory capabilities, leading to implicit confounding biases in offline data. We address the challenge by investigating the problem of confounded observations in offline RL from a causal perspective. We develop a novel causal offline RL objective that optimizes policies' worst-case performance that may arise due to confounding biases. Based on this new objective, we introduce a practical implementation that learns expressive flow-matching policies from confounded demonstrations, employing a deep discriminator to assess the discrepancy between the target policy and the nominal behavioral policy. Experiments across 25 pixel-based tasks demonstrate that our proposed confounding-robust augmentation procedure achieves a success rate 120\% that of confounding-unaware, state-of-the-art offline RL methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种应对离线强化学习中混淆观测问题的新方法，通过因果视角构建鲁棒的离线RL目标，学习表达能力强的流匹配策略，有效处理演示者与学习者的感知能力不匹配导致的隐式混淆偏差。
AI.motivation: 基于流匹配的表达性策略在离线强化学习中取得了成功，但传统策略梯度假设数据中不存在未测量的混淆因素。在像素级演示中，若演示者与学习者的感知能力存在错配，将导致离线数据产生隐式混淆偏差，现有方法对此不鲁棒。
AI.method: 提出了一种新的因果离线RL目标，优化策略在最坏情况下的性能以应对混淆偏差。基于该目标，通过流匹配策略学习表达性策略，并采用深度判别器评估目标策略与名义行为策略之间的差异。
AI.result: 在25个像素基任务上的实验显示，所提出的混淆鲁棒增强方法达到了无视混淆问题的先进离线RL方法120%的成功率。
AI.conclusion: 从因果视角处理混淆观测能够显著提升离线强化学习的鲁棒性，特别是在像素级任务中，为处理实际应用中的感知能力错配问题提供了有效解决方案。

title: Zero Sum SVD: Balancing Loss Sensitivity for Low Rank LLM Compression
summary: Advances in large language models have driven strong performance across many tasks, but their memory and compute costs still hinder deployment. SVD-based compression reduces storage and can speed up inference via low-rank factors, yet performance depends on how rank is allocated under a global compression ratio. Prior methods often use homogeneous ranks for similarly sized matrices, despite large differences in loss sensitivity, or rely on expensive iterative pre-truncation optimization to determine per matrix ranks. We propose \textbf{Zero Sum SVD} (\textbf{ZS-SVD}), a post-training method that performs \emph{global} singular component selection using activation whitening and first-order calibration loss estimates in whitened coordinates. \textbf{ZS-SVD} prunes components across the whole model with a \textbf{zero sum} rule that keeps the cumulative predicted loss change near zero, automatically yielding heterogeneous ranks without solving a rank allocation optimization. Motivated by evidence that gradients near pretrained solutions exhibit low rank structure, we also introduce an optional lightweight correction that applies a \textbf{single} projected gradient update after truncation, followed by re-truncation. Extensive experiments across multiple LLM architectures show consistent gains across diverse benchmarks and compression ratios. Code is available at https://github.com/mint-vu/Zero-Sum-SVD

AI.tldr: Advances in large language models have driven strong performance across many tasks, but their memory and compute costs still hinder deployment. SVD-based compression reduces storage and can speed up inference via low-rank factors, yet performance depends on how rank is allocated under a global compression ratio. Prior methods often use homogeneous ranks for similarly sized matrices, despite large differences in loss sensitivity, or rely on expensive iterative pre-truncation optimization to determine per matrix ranks. Motivated by evidence that gradients near pretrained solutions exhibit low rank structure, we also introduce an optional lightweight correction that applies a \textbf{single} projected gradient update after truncation, followed by re-truncation. title: Recurrent Equivariant Constraint Modulation: Learning Per-Layer Symmetry Relaxation from Data
summary: Equivariant neural networks exploit underlying task symmetries to improve generalization, but strict equivariance constraints can induce more complex optimization dynamics that can hinder learning. Prior work addresses these limitations by relaxing strict equivariance during training, but typically relies on prespecified, explicit, or implicit target levels of relaxation for each network layer, which are task-dependent and costly to tune. We propose Recurrent Equivariant Constraint Modulation (RECM), a layer-wise constraint modulation mechanism that learns appropriate relaxation levels solely from the training signal and the symmetry properties of each layer's input-target distribution, without requiring any prior knowledge about the task-dependent target relaxation level. We demonstrate that under the proposed RECM update, the relaxation level of each layer provably converges to a value upper-bounded by its symmetry gap, namely the degree to which its input-target distribution deviates from exact symmetry. Consequently, layers processing symmetric distributions recover full equivariance, while those with approximate symmetries retain sufficient flexibility to learn non-symmetric solutions when warranted by the data. Empirically, RECM outperforms prior methods across diverse exact and approximate equivariant tasks, including the challenging molecular conformer generation on the GEOM-Drugs dataset.

title: When pre-training hurts LoRA fine-tuning: a dynamical analysis via single-index models
summary: Pre-training on a source task is usually expected to facilitate fine-tuning on similar downstream problems. In this work, we mathematically show that this naive intuition is not always true: excessive pre-training can computationally slow down fine-tuning optimization. We study this phenomenon for low-rank adaptation (LoRA) fine-tuning on single-index models trained under one-pass SGD. Leveraging a summary statistics description of the fine-tuning dynamics, we precisely characterize how the convergence rate depends on the initial fine-tuning alignment and the degree of non-linearity of the target task. The key take away is that even when the pre-training and down- stream tasks are well aligned, strong pre-training can induce a prolonged search phase and hinder convergence. Our theory thus provides a unified picture of how pre-training strength and task difficulty jointly shape the dynamics and limitations of LoRA fine-tuning in a nontrivial tractable model.

title: Late-Stage Generalization Collapse in Grokking: Detecting anti-grokking with Weightwatcher
summary:
\emph{Memorization} in neural networks lacks a precise operational definition and is often inferred from the grokking regime, where training accuracy saturates while test accuracy remains very low. We identify a previously unreported third phase of grokking in this training regime: \emph{anti-grokking}, a late-stage collapse of generalization.
  We revisit two canonical grokking setups: a 3-layer MLP trained on a subset of MNIST and a transformer trained on modular addition, but extended training far beyond standard. In both cases, after models transition from pre-grokking to successful generalization, test accuracy collapses back to chance while training accuracy remains perfect, indicating a distinct post-generalization failure mode.
  To diagnose anti-grokking, we use the open-source \texttt{WeightWatcher} tool based on HTSR/SETOL theory. The primary signal is the emergence of \emph{Correlation Traps}: anomalously large eigenvalues beyond the Marchenko--Pastur bulk in the empirical spectral density of shuffled weight matrices, which are predicted to impair generalization. As a secondary signal, anti-grokking corresponds to the average HTSR layer quality metric $α$ deviating from $2.0$. Neither metric requires access to the test or training data.
  We compare these signals to alternative grokking diagnostic, including $\ell_2$ norms, Activation Sparsity, Absolute Weight Entropy, and Local Circuit Complexity. These track pre-grokking and grokking but fail to identify anti-grokking. Finally, we show that Correlation Traps can induce catastrophic forgetting and/or prototype memorization, and observe similar pathologies in large-scale LLMs, like OSS GPT 20/120B.

title: A Geometry-Aware Efficient Algorithm for Compositional Entropic Risk Minimization
summary: This paper studies optimization for a family of problems termed $\textbf{compositional entropic risk minimization}$, in which each data's loss is formulated as a Log-Expectation-Exponential (Log-E-Exp) function. The Log-E-Exp formulation serves as an abstraction of the Log-Sum-Exponential (LogSumExp) function when the explicit summation inside the logarithm is taken over a gigantic number of items and is therefore expensive to evaluate. While entropic risk objectives of this form arise in many machine learning problems, existing optimization algorithms suffer from several fundamental limitations including non-convergence, numerical instability, and slow convergence rates. To address these limitations, we propose a geometry-aware stochastic algorithm, termed $\textbf{SCENT}$, for the dual formulation of entropic risk minimization cast as a min--min optimization problem. The key to our design is a $\textbf{stochastic proximal mirror descent (SPMD)}$ update for the dual variable, equipped with a Bregman divergence induced by a negative exponential function that faithfully captures the geometry of the objective. Our main contributions are threefold: (i) we establish an $O(1/\sqrt{T})$ convergence rate of the proposed SCENT algorithm for convex problems; (ii) we theoretically characterize the advantages of SPMD over standard SGD update for optimizing the dual variable; and (iii) we demonstrate the empirical effectiveness of SCENT on extreme classification, partial AUC maximization, contrastive learning and distributionally robust optimization, where it consistently outperforms existing baselines.

title: Mixture of Concept Bottleneck Experts
summary: Concept Bottleneck Models (CBMs) promote interpretability by grounding predictions in human-understandable concepts. However, existing CBMs typically fix their task predictor to a single linear or Boolean expression, limiting both predictive accuracy and adaptability to diverse user needs. We propose Mixture of Concept Bottleneck Experts (M-CBEs), a framework that generalizes existing CBMs along two dimensions: the number of experts and the functional form of each expert, exposing an underexplored region of the design space. We investigate this region by instantiating two novel models: Linear M-CBE, which learns a finite set of linear expressions, and Symbolic M-CBE, which leverages symbolic regression to discover expert functions from data under user-specified operator vocabularies. Empirical evaluation demonstrates that varying the mixture size and functional form provides a robust framework for navigating the accuracy-interpretability trade-off, adapting to different user and task needs.

AI.tldr: M-CBEs扩展了概念瓶颈模型，引入专家混合机制以提升准确性并适应多样化用户需求，探索设计空间中的新维度。

title: Self-Soupervision: Cooking Model Soups without Labels
summary: Model soups are strange and strangely effective combinations of parameters. They take a model (the stock), fine-tune it into multiple models (the ingredients), and then mix their parameters back into one model (the soup) to improve predictions. While all known soups require supervised learning, and optimize the same loss on labeled data, our recipes for Self-\emph{Soup}ervision generalize soups to self-supervised learning (SSL). Our Self-Souping lets us flavor ingredients on new data sources, e.g. from unlabeled data from a task for transfer or from a shift for robustness. We show that Self-Souping on corrupted test data, then fine-tuning back on uncorrupted train data, boosts robustness by +3.5\% (ImageNet-C) and +7\% (LAION-C). Self-\emph{Soup}ervision also unlocks countless SSL algorithms to cook the diverse ingredients needed for more robust soups. We show for the first time that ingredients can differ in their SSL hyperparameters -- and more surprisingly, in their SSL algorithms. We cook soups of MAE, MoCoV3, and MMCR ingredients that are more accurate than any one single SSL ingredient.

AI.method: 提出Self-Souping方法：1）将基础模型（stock）在自监督设置下训练为多个模型（ingredients）；2）通过混合这些模型的参数形成新模型（soup）；3）支持使用不同自监督算法（如MAE、MoCoV3、MMCR）和超参数来产生多样化的成分；4）引入在损坏测试数据上进行Self-Souping，然后在未损坏训练数据上微调的流程来提升鲁棒性。

title: TraceNAS: Zero-shot LLM Pruning via Gradient Trace Correlation
summary: Structured pruning is essential for efficient deployment of Large Language Models (LLMs). The varying sensitivity of LLM sub-blocks to pruning necessitates the identification of optimal non-uniformly pruned models. Existing methods evaluate the importance of layers, attention heads, or weight channels in isolation. Such localized focus ignores the complex global structural dependencies that exist across the model. Training-aware structured pruning addresses global dependencies, but its computational cost can be just as expensive as post-pruning training. To alleviate the computational burden of training-aware pruning and capture global structural dependencies, we propose TraceNAS, a training-free Neural Architecture Search (NAS) framework that jointly explores structured pruning of LLM depth and width. TraceNAS identifies pruned models that maintain a high degree of loss landscape alignment with the pretrained model using a scale-invariant zero-shot proxy, effectively selecting models that exhibit maximal performance potential during post-pruning training. TraceNAS is highly efficient, enabling high-fidelity discovery of pruned models on a single GPU in 8.5 hours, yielding a 10$\times$ reduction in GPU-hours compared to training-aware methods. Evaluations on the Llama and Qwen families demonstrate that TraceNAS is competitive with training-aware baselines across commonsense and reasoning benchmarks.

title: Manifold-Constrained Energy-Based Transition Models for Offline Reinforcement Learning
summary: Model-based offline reinforcement learning is brittle under distribution shift: policy improvement drives rollouts into state--action regions weakly supported by the dataset, where compounding model error yields severe value overestimation. We propose Manifold-Constrained Energy-based Transition Models (MC-ETM), which train conditional energy-based transition models using a manifold projection--diffusion negative sampler. MC-ETM learns a latent manifold of next states and generates near-manifold hard negatives by perturbing latent codes and running Langevin dynamics in latent space with the learned conditional energy, sharpening the energy landscape around the dataset support and improving sensitivity to subtle out-of-distribution deviations. For policy optimization, the learned energy provides a single reliability signal: rollouts are truncated when the minimum energy over sampled next states exceeds a threshold, and Bellman backups are stabilized via pessimistic penalties based on Q-value-level dispersion across energy-guided samples. We formalize MC-ETM through a hybrid pessimistic MDP formulation and derive a conservative performance bound separating in-support evaluation error from truncation risk. Empirically, MC-ETM improves multi-step dynamics fidelity and yields higher normalized returns on standard offline control benchmarks, particularly under irregular dynamics and sparse data coverage.

title: Spatiotemporal Decision Transformer for Traffic Coordination
summary: Traffic signal control is a critical challenge in urban transportation, requiring coordination among multiple intersections to optimize network-wide traffic flow. While reinforcement learning has shown promise for adaptive signal control, existing methods struggle with multi-agent coordination and sample efficiency. We introduce MADT (Multi-Agent Decision Transformer), a novel approach that reformulates multi-agent traffic signal control as a sequence modeling problem. MADT extends the Decision Transformer paradigm to multi-agent settings by incorporating: (1) a graph attention mechanism for modeling spatial dependencies between intersections, (2) a|temporal transformer encoder for capturing traffic dynamics, and (3) return-to-go conditioning for target performance specification. Our approach enables offline learning from historical traffic data, with architecture design that facilitates potential online fine-tuning. Experiments on synthetic grid networks and real-world traffic scenarios demonstrate that MADT achieves state-of-the-art performance, reducing average travel time by 5-6% compared to the strongest baseline while exhibiting superior coordination among adjacent intersections.

title: A Random Matrix Theory Perspective on the Consistency of Diffusion Models
summary: Diffusion models trained on different, non-overlapping subsets of a dataset often produce strikingly similar outputs when given the same noise seed. We trace this consistency to a simple linear effect: the shared Gaussian statistics across splits already predict much of the generated images. To formalize this, we develop a random matrix theory (RMT) framework that quantifies how finite datasets shape the expectation and variance of the learned denoiser and sampling map in the linear setting. For expectations, sampling variability acts as a renormalization of the noise level through a self-consistent relation $σ^2 \mapsto κ(σ^2)$, explaining why limited data overshrink low-variance directions and pull samples toward the dataset mean. For fluctuations, our variance formulas reveal three key factors behind cross-split disagreement: \textit{anisotropy} across eigenmodes, \textit{inhomogeneity} across inputs, and overall scaling with dataset size. Extending deterministic-equivalence tools to fractional matrix powers further allows us to analyze entire sampling trajectories. The theory sharply predicts the behavior of linear diffusion models, and we validate its predictions on UNet and DiT architectures in their non-memorization regime, identifying where and how samples deviates across training data split. This provides a principled baseline for reproducibility in diffusion training, linking spectral properties of data to the stability of generative outputs.

title: Notes on the Reward Representation of Posterior Updates
summary: Many ideas in modern control and reinforcement learning treat decision-making as inference: start from a baseline distribution and update it when a signal arrives. We ask when this can be made literal rather than metaphorical. title: Weighted Temporal Decay Loss for Learning Wearable PPG Data with Sparse Clinical Labels
summary: Advances in wearable computing and AI have increased interest in leveraging PPG for health monitoring over the past decade. One of the biggest challenges in developing health algorithms based on such biosignals is the sparsity of clinical labels, which makes biosignals temporally distant from lab draws less reliable for supervision. To address this problem, we introduce a simple training strategy that learns a biomarker-specific decay of sample weight over the time gap between a segment and its ground truth label and uses this weight in the loss with a regularizer to prevent trivial solutions. On smartwatch PPG from 450 participants across 10 biomarkers, the approach improves over baselines. In the subject-wise setting, the proposed approach averages 0.715 AUPRC, compared to 0.674 for a fine-tuned self-supervised baseline and 0.626 for a feature-based Random Forest. A comparison of four decay families shows that a simple linear decay function is most robust on average. Beyond accuracy, the learned decay rates summarize how quickly each biomarker's PPG evidence becomes stale, providing an interpretable view of temporal sensitivity.

title: A Reproducible Framework for Bias-Resistant Machine Learning on Small-Sample Neuroimaging Data
comment: Accepted to ISBI 2026, 5 pages with 1 figure
summary: We introduce a reproducible, bias-resistant machine learning framework that integrates domain-informed feature engineering, nested cross-validation, and calibrated decision-threshold optimization for small-sample neuroimaging data. title: How Does the Lagrangian Guide Safe Reinforcement Learning through Diffusion Models?
summary: Diffusion policy sampling enables reinforcement learning (RL) to represent multimodal action distributions beyond suboptimal unimodal Gaussian policies. However, existing diffusion-based RL methods primarily focus on offline settings for reward maximization, with limited consideration of safety in online settings. To address this gap, we propose Augmented Lagrangian-Guided Diffusion (ALGD), a novel algorithm for off-policy safe RL. By revisiting optimization theory and energy-based model, we show that the instability of primal-dual methods arises from the non-convex Lagrangian landscape. In diffusion-based safe RL, the Lagrangian can be interpreted as an energy function guiding the denoising dynamics. Counterintuitively, direct usage destabilizes both policy generation and training. ALGD resolves this issue by introducing an augmented Lagrangian that locally convexifies the energy landscape, yielding a stabilized policy generation and training process without altering the distribution of the optimal policy. Theoretical analysis and extensive experiments demonstrate that ALGD is both theoretically grounded and empirically effective, achieving strong and stable performance across diverse environments.

title: Refining Decision Boundaries In Anomaly Detection Using Similarity Search Within the Feature Space
summary: Detecting rare and diverse anomalies in highly imbalanced datasets-such as Advanced Persistent Threats (APTs) in cybersecurity-remains a fundamental challenge for machine learning systems. Active learning offers a promising direction by strategically querying an oracle to minimize labeling effort, yet conventional approaches often fail to exploit the intrinsic geometric structure of the feature space for model refinement. In this paper, we introduce SDA2E, a Sparse Dual Adversarial Attention-based AutoEncoder designed to learn compact and discriminative latent representations from imbalanced, high-dimensional data. We further propose a similarity-guided active learning framework that integrates three novel strategies to refine decision boundaries efficiently: mormal-like expansion, which enriches the training set with points similar to labeled normals to improve reconstruction fidelity; anomaly-like prioritization, which boosts ranking accuracy by focusing on points resembling known anomalies; and a hybrid strategy that combines both for balanced model refinement and ranking. A key component of our framework is a new similarity measure, Normalized Matching 1s (SIM_NM1), tailored for sparse binary embeddings. We evaluate SDA2E extensively across 52 imbalanced datasets, including multiple DARPA Transparent Computing scenarios, and benchmark it against 15 state-of-the-art anomaly detection methods. Results demonstrate that SDA2E consistently achieves superior ranking performance (nDCG up to 1.0 in several cases) while reducing the required labeled data by up to 80% compared to passive training. Statistical tests confirm the significance of these improvements. Our work establishes a robust, efficient, and statistically validated framework for anomaly detection that is particularly suited to cybersecurity applications such as APT detection.

title: Distance Marching for Generative Modeling
summary: Time-unconditional generative models learn time-independent denoising vector fields. But without time conditioning, the same noisy input may correspond to multiple noise levels and different denoising directions, which interferes with the supervision signal. Inspired by distance field modeling, we propose Distance Marching, a new time-unconditional approach with two principled inference methods. Crucially, we design losses that focus on closer targets. This yields denoising directions better directed toward the data manifold. Across architectures, Distance Marching consistently improves FID by 13.5% on CIFAR-10 and ImageNet over recent time-unconditional baselines. For class-conditional ImageNet generation, despite removing time input, Distance Marching surpasses flow matching using our losses and inference methods. It achieves lower FID than flow matching's final performance using 60% of the sampling steps and 13.6% lower FID on average across backbone sizes. Moreover, our distance prediction is also helpful for early stopping during sampling and for OOD detection. We hope distance field modeling can serve as a principled lens for generative modeling.

title: RPG-AE: Neuro-Symbolic Graph Autoencoders with Rare Pattern Mining for Provenance-Based Anomaly Detection
summary: Advanced Persistent Threats (APTs) are sophisticated, long-term cyberattacks that are difficult to detect because they operate stealthily and often blend into normal system behavior. This paper presents a neuro-symbolic anomaly detection framework that combines a Graph Autoencoder (GAE) with rare pattern mining to identify APT-like activities in system-level provenance data. Our approach first constructs a process behavioral graph using k-Nearest Neighbors based on feature similarity, then learns normal relational structure using a Graph Autoencoder. Anomaly candidates are identified through deviations between observed and reconstructed graph structure. To further improve detection, we integrate an rare pattern mining module that discovers infrequent behavioral co-occurrences and uses them to boost anomaly scores for processes exhibiting rare signatures. We evaluate the proposed method on the DARPA Transparent Computing datasets and show that rare-pattern boosting yields substantial gains in anomaly ranking quality over the baseline GAE. Compared with existing unsupervised approaches on the same benchmark, our single unified model consistently outperforms individual context-based detectors and achieves performance competitive with ensemble aggregation methods that require multiple separate detectors. These results highlight the value of coupling graph-based representation learning with classical pattern mining to improve both effectiveness and interpretability in provenance-based security anomaly detection.

title: Rare Event Early Detection: A Dataset of Sepsis Onset for Critically Ill Trauma Patients
summary: Sepsis is a major public health concern due to its high morbidity, mortality, and cost. Its clinical outcome can be substantially improved through early detection and timely intervention. By leveraging publicly available datasets, machine learning (ML) has driven advances in both research and clinical practice. However, existing public datasets consider ICU patients (Intensive Care Unit) as a uniform group and neglect the potential challenges presented by critically ill trauma patients in whom injury-related inflammation and organ dysfunction can overlap with the clinical features of sepsis. We propose that a targeted identification of post-traumatic sepsis is necessary in order to develop methods for early detection. Therefore, we introduce a publicly available standardized post-trauma sepsis onset dataset extracted, relabeled using standardized post-trauma clinical facts, and validated from MIMIC-III. Furthermore, we frame early detection of post-trauma sepsis onset according to clinical workflow in ICUs in a daily basis resulting in a new rare event detection problem. We then establish a general benchmark through comprehensive experiments, which shows the necessity of further advancements using this new dataset. The data code is available at https://github.com/ML4UWHealth/SepsisOnset_TraumaCohort.git.

title: 3D-Learning: Diffusion-Augmented Distributionally Robust Decision-Focused Learning
summary: Predict-then-Optimize (PTO) pipelines are widely employed in computing and networked systems, where Machine Learning (ML) models are used to predict critical contextual information for downstream decision-making tasks such as cloud LLM serving, data center demand response, and edge workload scheduling. However, these ML predictors are often vulnerable to out-of-distribution (OOD) samples at test time, leading to significant decision performance degradation due to large prediction errors. To address the generalization challenges under OOD conditions, we present the framework of Distributionally Robust Decision-Focused Learning (DR-DFL), which trains ML models to optimize decision performance under the worst-case distribution. Instead of relying on classical Distributionally Robust Optimization (DRO) techniques, we propose Diffusion-Augmented Distributionally Robust Decision-Focused Learning (3D-Learning), which searches for the worst-case distribution within the parameterized space of a diffusion model. By leveraging the powerful distribution modeling capabilities of diffusion models, 3D-Learning identifies worst-case distributions that remain consistent with real data, achieving a favorable balance between average and worst-case scenarios. Empirical results on an LLM resource provisioning task demonstrate that 3D-Learning outperforms existing DRO and Data Augmentation methods in OOD generalization performance.

title: Variational Sparse Paired Autoencoders (vsPAIR) for Inverse Problems and Uncertainty Quantification
summary:
Inverse problems are fundamental to many scientific and engineering disciplines; they arise when one seeks to reconstruct hidden, underlying quantities from noisy measurements. Many applications demand not just point estimates but interpretable uncertainty. Providing fast inference alongside uncertainty estimates remains challenging yet desirable in numerous applications.
  We propose the Variational Sparse Paired Autoencoder (vsPAIR) to address this challenge. The architecture pairs a standard VAE encoding observations with a sparse VAE encoding quantities of interest, connected through a learned latent mapping. The variational structure enables uncertainty estimation, the paired architecture encourages interpretability by anchoring QoI representations to clean data, and sparse encodings provide structure by concentrating information into identifiable factors rather than diffusing across all dimensions. We also propose modifications to existing sparse VAE methods: a hard-concrete spike-and-slab relaxation for differentiable training and a beta hyperprior for adaptive sparsity levels. To validate the effectiveness of our proposed architecture, we conduct experiments on blind inpainting and computed tomography, demonstrating that vsPAIR is a capable inverse problem solver that can provide interpretable and structured uncertainty estimates.

title: Quant VideoGen: Auto-Regressive Long Video Generation via 2-Bit KV-Cache Quantization
summary: Despite rapid progress in autoregressive video diffusion, an emerging system algorithm bottleneck limits both deployability and generation capability: KV cache memory. In autoregressive video generation models, the KV cache grows with generation history and quickly dominates GPU memory, often exceeding 30 GB, preventing deployment on widely available hardware. More critically, constrained KV cache budgets restrict the effective working memory, directly degrading long horizon consistency in identity, layout, and motion. To address this challenge, we present Quant VideoGen (QVG), a training free KV cache quantization framework for autoregressive video diffusion models. QVG leverages video spatiotemporal redundancy through Semantic Aware Smoothing, producing low magnitude, quantization friendly residuals. It further introduces Progressive Residual Quantization, a coarse to fine multi stage scheme that reduces quantization error while enabling a smooth quality memory trade off. Across LongCat Video, HY WorldPlay, and Self Forcing benchmarks, QVG establishes a new Pareto frontier between quality and memory efficiency, reducing KV cache memory by up to 7.0 times with less than 4% end to end latency overhead while consistently outperforming existing baselines in generation quality.

title: Human-Centric Traffic Signal Control for Equity: A Multi-Agent Action Branching Deep Reinforcement Learning Approach
summary: Coordinating traffic signals along multimodal corridors is challenging because many multi-agent deep reinforcement learning (DRL) approaches remain vehicle-centric and struggle with high-dimensional discrete action spaces. We propose MA2B-DDQN, a human-centric multi-agent action-branching double Deep Q-Network (DQN) framework that explicitly optimizes traveler-level equity. Our key contribution is an action-branching discrete control formulation that decomposes corridor control into (i) local, per-intersection actions that allocate green time between the next two phases and (ii) a single global action that selects the total duration of those phases. This decomposition enables scalable coordination under discrete control while reducing the effective complexity of joint decision-making. We also design a human-centric reward that penalizes the number of delayed individuals in the corridor, accounting for pedestrians, vehicle occupants, and transit passengers. Extensive evaluations across seven realistic traffic scenarios in Melbourne, Australia, demonstrate that our approach significantly reduces the number of impacted travelers, outperforming existing DRL and baseline methods. Experiments confirm the robustness of our model, showing minimal variance across diverse settings. This framework not only advocates for a fairer traffic signal system but also provides a scalable solution adaptable to varied urban traffic conditions.

title: Q-ShiftDP: A Differentially Private Parameter-Shift Rule for Quantum Machine Learning
summary: Quantum Machine Learning (QML) promises significant computational advantages, but preserving training data privacy remains challenging. Classical approaches like differentially private stochastic gradient descent (DP-SGD) add noise to gradients but fail to exploit the unique properties of quantum gradient estimation. In this work, we introduce the Differentially Private Parameter-Shift Rule (Q-ShiftDP), the first privacy mechanism tailored to QML. By leveraging the inherent boundedness and stochasticity of quantum gradients computed via the parameter-shift rule, Q-ShiftDP enables tighter sensitivity analysis and reduces noise requirements. We combine carefully calibrated Gaussian noise with intrinsic quantum noise to provide formal privacy and utility guarantees, and show that harnessing quantum noise further improves the privacy-utility trade-off. Experiments on benchmark datasets demonstrate that Q-ShiftDP consistently outperforms classical DP methods in QML.

title: Co2PO: Coordinated Constrained Policy Optimization for Multi-Agent RL
summary: Constrained multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) faces a fundamental tension between exploration and safety-constrained optimization. Existing leading approaches, such as Lagrangian methods, typically rely on global penalties or centralized critics that react to violations after they occur, often suppressing exploration and leading to over-conservatism. We propose Co2PO, a novel MARL communication-augmented framework that enables coordination-driven safety through selective, risk-aware communication. Co2PO introduces a shared blackboard architecture for broadcasting positional intent and yield signals, governed by a learned hazard predictor that proactively forecasts potential violations over an extended temporal horizon. By integrating these forecasts into a constrained optimization objective, Co2PO allows agents to anticipate and navigate collective hazards without the performance trade-offs inherent in traditional reactive constraints. We evaluate Co2PO across a suite of complex multi-agent safety benchmarks, where it achieves higher returns compared to leading constrained baselines while converging to cost-compliant policies at deployment. Ablation studies further validate the necessity of risk-triggered communication, adaptive gating, and shared memory components.

title: Why Some Models Resist Unlearning: A Linear Stability Perspective
summary: Machine unlearning, the ability to erase the effect of specific training samples without retraining from scratch, is critical for privacy, regulation, and efficiency. However, most progress in unlearning has been empirical, with little theoretical understanding of when and why unlearning works. We tackle this gap by framing unlearning through the lens of asymptotic linear stability to capture the interaction between optimization dynamics and data geometry. The key quantity in our analysis is data coherence which is the cross sample alignment of loss surface directions near the optimum. We decompose coherence along three axes: within the retain set, within the forget set, and between them, and prove tight stability thresholds that separate convergence from divergence. To further link data properties to forgettability, we study a two layer ReLU CNN under a signal plus noise model and show that stronger memorization makes forgetting easier: when the signal to noise ratio (SNR) is lower, cross sample alignment is weaker, reducing coherence and making unlearning easier; conversely, high SNR, highly aligned models resist unlearning. For empirical verification, we show that Hessian tests and CNN heatmaps align closely with the predicted boundary, mapping the stability frontier of gradient based unlearning as a function of batching, mixing, and data/model alignment. Our analysis is grounded in random matrix theory tools and provides the first principled account of the trade offs between memorization, coherence, and unlearning.

AI.tldr: 本文通过渐进线性稳定性框架，从理论上分析了机器遗忘的有效性，提出了数据相干性概念，并证明其为决定遗忘成败的关键因素。研究发现数据对齐程度越低，遗忘越容易。
AI.motivation: 当前机器遗忘研究缺乏理论指导，实践中多依赖经验方法。本文旨在建立遗忘过程的理论基础，解释为何在某些情况下遗忘有效而在其他情况下失效，填补理论与实践的鸿沟。

AI.result: 1) 证明了数据相干性是决定遗忘有效性的关键：遗忘集与保留集之间的交错对齐度越低，越容易遗忘；2) 在CNN模型中，信噪比越低（记忆越弱），交叉样本对齐越弱，相干性越小，遗忘越容易；信噪比高、高度对齐的模型则抗拒遗忘；3) Hessian检验和CNN热图与预测边界高度一致，验证了梯度遗忘的稳定性边界。
